arabic: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
transliteration: Qaaaf; wal Qur aanil Majeed

translations.en.sahih: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
translations.en.pickthall: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,
translations.en.yusufali: Qaf: By the Glorious Qur'an (Thou art Allah's Messenger).
translations.id.indonesian: Qaaf Demi Al Quran yang sangat mulia.

arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
transliteration: Bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb

translations.en.sahih: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
translations.en.yusufali: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
translations.id.indonesian: (Mereka tidak menerimanya) bahkan mereka tercengang karena telah datang kepada mereka seorang pemberi peringatan dari (kalangan) mereka sendiri, maka berkatalah orang-orang kafir: "Ini adalah suatu yang amat ajaib".

arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
transliteration: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed

translations.en.sahih: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
translations.en.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!
translations.en.yusufali: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah kami setelah mati dan setelah menjadi tanah (kami akan kembali lagi)?, itu adalah suatu pengembalian yang tidak mungkin.

arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
transliteration: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul-ardu minhum wa 'indanaa Kitaabun Hafeez

translations.en.sahih: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
translations.en.pickthall: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
translations.en.yusufali: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mengetahui apa yang dihancurkan oleh bumi dari (tubuh-tubuh) mereka, dan pada sisi Kamipun ada kitab yang memelihara (mencatat).

arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
transliteration: Bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej

translations.en.sahih: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
translations.en.yusufali: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya, mereka telah mendustakan kebenaran tatkala kebenaran itu datang kepada mereka, maka mereka berada dalam keadaan kacau balau.

arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
transliteration: Afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa wa zaiyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj

translations.en.sahih: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
translations.en.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
translations.en.yusufali: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah mereka tidak melihat akan langit yang ada di atas mereka, bagaimana Kami meninggikannya dan menghiasinya dan langit itu tidak mempunyai retak-retak sedikitpun?

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
transliteration: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej

translations.en.sahih: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
translations.en.yusufali: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami hamparkan bumi itu dan Kami letakkan padanya gunung-gunung yang kokoh dan Kami tumbuhkan padanya segala macam tanaman yang indah dipandang mata,

arabic: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
transliteration: Tabsiratanw wa zikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb

translations.en.sahih: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.
translations.en.yusufali: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: untuk menjadi pelajaran dan peringatan bagi tiap-tiap hamba yang kembali (mengingat Allah).

arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
transliteration: Wa nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw wa habbal haseed

translations.en.sahih: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
translations.en.pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
translations.en.yusufali: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami turunkan dari langit air yang banyak manfaatnya lalu Kami tumbuhkan dengan air itu pohon-pohon dan biji-biji tanaman yang diketam,

arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
transliteration: Wannakhla baasiqaatil laha tal'un nadeed

translations.en.sahih: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
translations.en.pickthall: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
translations.en.yusufali: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan pohon kurma yang tinggi-tinggi yang mempunyai mayang yang bersusun-susun,

arabic: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
transliteration: Rizqal lil'ibaad, wa ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj

translations.en.sahih: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
translations.en.pickthall: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
translations.en.yusufali: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
translations.id.indonesian: untuk menjadi rezeki bagi hamba-hamba (Kami), dan Kami hidupkan dengan air itu tanah yang mati (kering). Seperti itulah terjadinya kebangkitan.

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
transliteration: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wa Ashaabur Rassi wa Samood

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
translations.en.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
translations.en.yusufali: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
translations.id.indonesian: Sebelum mereka telah mendustakan (pula) kaum Nuh dan penduduk Rass dan Tsamud,

arabic: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
transliteration: Wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu wikhwaanu loot

translations.en.sahih: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
translations.en.pickthall: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
translations.en.yusufali: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
translations.id.indonesian: dan kaum Aad, kaum Fir'aun dan kaum Luth,

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
transliteration: Wa Ashaabul Aykati wa qawmu Tubba'; kullun kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa wa'eed

translations.en.sahih: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
translations.en.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
translations.en.yusufali: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
translations.id.indonesian: dan penduduk Aikah serta kaum Tubba' semuanya telah mendustakan rasul-rasul maka sudah semestinyalah mereka mendapat hukuman yang sudah diancamkan.

arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
transliteration: Afa'a yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed

translations.en.sahih: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
translations.en.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
translations.en.yusufali: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah Kami letih dengan penciptaan yang pertama? Sebenarnya mereka dalam keadaan ragu-ragu tentang penciptaan yang baru.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wa Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed

translations.en.sahih: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
translations.en.pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
translations.en.yusufali: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dan mengetahui apa yang dibisikkan oleh hatinya, dan Kami lebih dekat kepadanya daripada urat lehernya,

arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
transliteration: 'Iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi yaani 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali qa'eed

translations.en.sahih: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
translations.en.pickthall: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) ketika dua orang malaikat mencatat amal perbuatannya, seorang duduk di sebelah kanan dan yang lain duduk di sebelah kiri.

arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
transliteration: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed

translations.en.sahih: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
translations.en.pickthall: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
translations.en.yusufali: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
translations.id.indonesian: Tiada suatu ucapanpun yang diucapkannya melainkan ada di dekatnya malaikat pengawas yang selalu hadir.

arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
transliteration: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

translations.en.sahih: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
translations.en.pickthall: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
translations.en.yusufali: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan datanglah sakaratul maut dengan sebenar-benarnya. Itulah yang kamu selalu lari daripadanya.

arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
transliteration: Wa nufikha fis Soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed

translations.en.sahih: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
translations.en.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
translations.en.yusufali: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ditiuplah sangkakala. Itulah hari terlaksananya ancaman.

arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
transliteration: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

translations.en.sahih: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
translations.en.pickthall: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
translations.en.yusufali: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan datanglah tiap-tiap diri, bersama dengan dia seorang malaikat penggiring dan seorang malaikat penyaksi.

arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
transliteration: Laqad kunta fee ghaf latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed

translations.en.sahih: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
translations.en.pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
translations.en.yusufali: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kamu berada dalam keadaan lalai dari (hal) ini, maka Kami singkapkan daripadamu tutup (yang menutupi) matamu, maka penglihatanmu pada hari itu amat tajam.

arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
transliteration: Wa qaala qareenuhoo haazaa maa ladaiya 'ateed

translations.en.sahih: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
translations.en.pickthall: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
translations.en.yusufali: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan yang menyertai dia berkata: "Inilah (catatan amalnya) yang tersedia pada sisiku".

arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
transliteration: Alqiyaa fee Jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed

translations.en.sahih: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
translations.en.pickthall: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
translations.en.yusufali: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Lemparkanlah olehmu berdua ke dalam neraka semua orang yang sangat ingkar dan keras kepala,

arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
transliteration: Mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb

translations.en.sahih: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
translations.en.pickthall: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
translations.en.yusufali: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
translations.id.indonesian: yang sangat menghalangi kebajikan, melanggar batas lagi ragu-ragu,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
transliteration: Allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa alqiyaahu fil'azaabish shadeed

translations.en.sahih: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
translations.en.pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
translations.en.yusufali: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
translations.id.indonesian: yang menyembah sembahan yang lain beserta Allah maka lemparkanlah dia ke dalam siksaan yang sangat".

arabic: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
transliteration: Qaala qareenuhoo Rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo wa laakin kaana fee dalaahim ba'eed

translations.en.sahih: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
translations.en.pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
translations.en.yusufali: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
translations.id.indonesian: Yang menyertai dia berkata (pula): "Ya Tuhan kami, aku tidak menyesatkannya tetapi dialah yang berada dalam kesesatan yang jauh".

arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
transliteration: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
translations.en.pickthall: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
translations.en.yusufali: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Janganlah kamu bertengkar di hadapan-Ku, padahal sesungguhnya Aku dahulu telah memberikan ancaman kepadamu".

arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
transliteration: Maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya wa maaa ana bizal laamil lil'abeed

translations.en.sahih: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
translations.en.pickthall: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
translations.en.yusufali: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
translations.id.indonesian: Keputusan di sisi-Ku tidak dapat diubah dan Aku sekali-kali tidak menganiaya hamba-hamba-Ku

arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
transliteration: Yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati wa taqoolu hal mim mazeed

translations.en.sahih: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
translations.en.yusufali: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
translations.id.indonesian: (Dan ingatlah akan) hari (yang pada hari itu) Kami bertanya kepada jahannam: "Apakah kamu sudah penuh?" Dia menjawab: "Masih ada tambahan?"

arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
transliteration: Wa uzlifatil jannatu lil muttaqeena ghaira ba'eed

translations.en.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
translations.en.pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
translations.en.yusufali: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan didekatkanlah surga itu kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa pada tempat yang tiada jauh (dari mereka).

arabic: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
transliteration: Haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez

translations.en.sahih: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
translations.en.pickthall: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
translations.en.yusufali: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah yang dijanjikan kepadamu, (yaitu) kepada setiap hamba yang selalu kembali (kepada Allah) lagi memelihara (semua peraturan-peraturan-Nya)

arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
transliteration: Man khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaibi wa jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb

translations.en.sahih: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
translations.en.pickthall: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
translations.en.yusufali: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) orang yang takut kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah sedang Dia tidak kelihatan (olehnya) dan dia datang dengan hati yang bertaubat,

arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
transliteration: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin zaalika yawmul khulood

translations.en.sahih: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
translations.en.pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
translations.en.yusufali: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
translations.id.indonesian: masukilah surga itu dengan aman, itulah hari kekekalan.

arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
transliteration: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa wa ladainaa mazeed

translations.en.sahih: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
translations.en.pickthall: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
translations.en.yusufali: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka di dalamnya memperoleh apa yang mereka kehendaki; dan pada sisi Kami ada tambahannya.

arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
transliteration: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees

translations.en.sahih: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
translations.en.pickthall: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
translations.en.yusufali: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berapa banyaknya umat-umat yang telah Kami binasakan sebelum mereka yang mereka itu lebih besar kekuatannya daripada mereka ini, maka mereka (yang telah dibinasakan itu) telah pernah menjelajah di beberapa negeri. Adakah (mereka) mendapat tempat lari (dari kebinasaan)?

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a wa huwa shaheed

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat peringatan bagi orang-orang yang mempunyai akal atau yang menggunakan pendengarannya, sedang dia menyaksikannya.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa mil lughoob

translations.en.sahih: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
translations.en.yusufali: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami ciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada antara keduanya dalam enam masa, dan Kami sedikitpun tidak ditimpa keletihan.

arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
transliteration: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qablal ghuroob

translations.en.sahih: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
translations.en.yusufali: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bersabarlah kamu terhadap apa yang mereka katakan dan bertasbihlah sambil memuji Tuhanmu sebelum terbit matahari dan sebelum terbenam(nya).

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
transliteration: Wa minal laili fasabbih hu wa adbaaras sujood

translations.en.sahih: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
translations.en.pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
translations.en.yusufali: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bertasbihlah kamu kepada-Nya di malam hari dan setiap selesai sembahyang.

arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
transliteration: Wastami' yawma yunaa dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb

translations.en.sahih: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
translations.en.pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
translations.en.yusufali: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan dengarkanlah (seruan) pada hari penyeru (malaikat) menyeru dari tempat yang dekat.

arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
transliteration: Yawma yasmaoonas sai hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj

translations.en.sahih: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
translations.en.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
translations.en.yusufali: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) pada hari mereka mendengar teriakan dengan sebenar-benarnya itulah hari ke luar (dari kubur).

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilainal maseer

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menghidupkan dan mematikan dan hanya kepada Kami-lah tempat kembali (semua makhluk).

arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
translations.en.yusufali: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) pada hari bumi terbelah-belah menampakkan mereka (lalu mereka ke luar) dengan cepat. Yang demikian itu adalah pengumpulan yang mudah bagi Kami.

arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
transliteration: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maaa anta 'alihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil quraani many yakhaafu wa'eed

translations.en.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
translations.en.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
translations.en.yusufali: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
translations.id.indonesian: Kami lebih mengetahui tentang apa yang mereka katakan, dan kamu sekali-kali bukanlah seorang pemaksa terhadap mereka. Maka beri peringatanlah dengan Al Quran orang yang takut dengan ancaman-Ku.
